title: Emrys and the Lantern
author: P. M. Halloran
blurb: Cyrus Thornbury, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
